user.compedNotice: Complimentary access until {date}. Everything is unlocked and the account won't expire or be deleted before then.
user.selfNotice: This is your own account, so suspending and deleting are turned off here.
user.extendTrialBody: Adds days to the trial. An ended trial starts again from today, and the deletion date is cleared.
user.grantCompBody: Full access (every feature and downloads) until the end of the chosen day. The account can't expire or be deleted while it lasts.
user.removeCompBody: The account goes back to its subscription state straight away. If that state is read-only, it keeps its full grace period before anything is deleted.
user.cancelSubBody: No refund is made here. For a refund, use the Stripe dashboard.
user.cancelAtEnd: At the end of the paid period
user.suspendBody: They're signed out everywhere and can't sign in or use the app. Their events stay viewable for guests but read-only: no uploads, no downloads.
user.unsuspendBody: They can sign in again and their events work as their plan allows.
user.deleteBody: Cancels any Stripe subscription immediately, then deletes the account, every event it owns and all their files. This can't be undone.

events.title: Every
events.searchPlaceholder: Title, link code or owner email

event.lockedNotice: Guest uploads were closed by an admin on {date}. The event is read-only until it's reopened.
event.ownerSuspended: The owner's account is suspended, so this event is read-only.
event.lockBody: Overrides the plan: nobody can upload, and the hosts can't change settings. Viewing, the live wall and downloads keep working.
event.unlockBody: The event follows the owner's plan again.
event.archiveBody: Guests can no longer open it (guest page, live wall, share links). The hosts still see it. Files are kept.
event.deleteBody: Deletes the event and every file in it. This can't be undone.
event.typeSlug: Type the link code {slug} to confirm

media.deleteBody: The files are deleted from storage. This can't be undone.

moderation.title: Needs a
moderation.lead: Photos and videos guests reported, and shots the automatic check held back, across every event. Newest first.
moderation.empty: All clear. Nothing waiting for review.
moderation.blockBody: Everything they uploaded to this event is hidden, and their device can't upload or join again. You can unblock them later.

system.title: System
system.integrationsLead: Only whether each setting is present. Secret values are never shown here.

cronLead.expiry: Daily: trial reminders, ended trials, failed-payment grace, cancellations and deletion warnings.
cronLead.cleanup: Daily: deletes files of lapsed accounts, abandoned uploads, old login codes and expired share links.

runBody.expiry: Runs the same job as the daily schedule. It is safe to repeat: each account is only processed once per step. Emails may be sent.
runBody.cleanup: Runs the same job as the daily schedule. Files of accounts past their deletion date are deleted for good.

system.runDone: Done. The run is listed below.
